description: Land Title Settlement Department - Watarappala, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521006 (7571)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel records, including amendments to ownership types (co-ownership), servitude rights, land extent corrections, and expungement of particulars. The content focuses entirely on land administration matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other non-land related administrative matters.
